skills.description: 本技能用于评估一个人是否具备启动「一人公司 / 单人创业 / solo business」的可行性，并输出可落地的差距清单与行动路线图。适用场景与触发词：用户询问「我能不能做一人公司」「一人公司可行性」「我适不适合裸辞创业」「副业能不能转全职」「我还差什么才能自己干」「一人公司诊断」「solo company feasibility / gap diagnosis / am I ready to go solo」。当用户输入自身现状（在职/裸辞/副业、技能、客户、资金、时间、心理承受度）并希望得到「能不能做 + 差在哪 + 下一步怎么补」的结构化诊断时使用本技能。本技能不做简单的 yes/no，而是输出「否决红线筛查 → 六维加权评分 → 四档可行性分级 → 差距量化（三类+显隐结构归因）→ 定制化弥补路径 → 风险提示 → 标准化输出 → 月度复检」的完整闭环。
skills.description_zh: 评估一人公司（单人创业）可行性：采集现状、筛查红线、六维加权打分、输出差距清单与 90 天行动路线图。适合纠结「能不能裸辞」「副业能不能转正」「我还差什么」的人。
skills.name: 一人公司可行性诊断与差距导航

skills.description: 【世界药师节·AI药学技能大赛参赛作品】This skill should be used when pharmacists or clinical pharmacists need to organize patient medication evidence (images, PDFs, prescriptions, medical records, long-term and temporary orders, lab reports, patient-brought drug photos, and interview notes) into a Best Possible Medication History (BPMH), identify discrepancies between pre-admission/home medications and inpatient orders, and produce a draft for review prior to generating the 表 A.1 医疗机构药物重整记录表 Word document required by the Chinese hospital pharmacy standard T/CHAS 20-2-3—2021. Triggered by requests involving admission/transfer/discharge medication reconciliation, BPMH construction, order discrepancy detection, pharmacist review drafts, or 表 A.1 generation. Final adjustments require human confirmation by a pharmacist and the responsible physician before any signature; the skill never auto-signs, auto-decides on medication changes, or fabricates drug names, doses, or frequencies.

skills.description:
This skill should be used when users ask for stories, anecdotes, campus folklore,
notable alumni, campus spots, photo locations, or food recommendations related to
Jilin University (吉林大学 / 吉大). It covers six categories: school history (历史故事),
institutional anecdotes (典故), unverified campus legends / mysterious tales (诡秘故事),
distinguished alumni (杰出校友), campus spots & photo spots (景点打卡/出片机位),
and campus food / nearby eats (美食探校). It routes each request by category,
strictly separates verified facts from unverified folklore, cites authoritative
sources, and adapts tone/format to the audience (新生 / 校友 / 考生 / 游客 / 短视频脚本).
Trigger phrases include "吉大的历史/校史", "吉大有什么典故", "吉大灵异/诡异/传说",
"吉大出了哪些名人/校友", "吉大哪里拍照好看", "吉大有什么好吃的/食堂/桂林路",
"讲个吉大的故事", "给新生介绍吉大", "用我的照片做个视频", "上传照片生成短视频",
"用自己的文案和图片做视频". It can also render a story/script into a subtitled
short-video MP4 via edge-tts + ffmpeg, with synced image backgrounds, an optional
title card, optional background music, and subtitle auto-wrapping, when the user
wants a video deliverable.
skills.description_zh: |当用户咨询吉林大学相关的历史故事、典故、诡秘/都市传说、杰出校友、景点拍照机位或美食推荐时使用。覆盖六类内容并严格分层标注（L1 已核实 / L2 传闻），来源可溯、场景适配（新生/校友/考生/游客/短视频脚本）。支持把口播脚本渲染为带字幕的竖屏短视频 MP4（edge-tts 播音级配音 + ffmpeg 烧录 ASS 字幕），可选片头标题卡、背景音乐与用户自备图片，诡秘内容强制「校园传说·未经证实」标注。
skills.name: 吉林大学故事库（JLU Campus Stories）
